name: Nubank USD Stablecoin
oneLiner: USD-NU is Nubank's pre-launch dollar-pegged stablecoin pilot for credit-card payments across 100M+ LATAM customers; ticker, chain, and backing model undecided.
collateral: Pre-launch: backing not disclosed. Nubank vice-chair Roberto Campos Neto announced a USD-pegged stablecoin pilot at Meridian 2025, framed inside a broader plan to tokenize deposits and issue credit against tokenized assets. Whether Nubank issues its own dollar token or routes through an existing stablecoin (USDC/PYUSD/other) is undecided.
pegMechanism: Pre-launch: not disclosed. Reported product surface is credit-card-rail stablecoin payments within Nubank's existing 100M+ LATAM customer app. Ticker, chain, reserve disclosure model, mint/redeem rails, and KYC perimeter are all undecided per Campos Neto's framing.

launchPhaseDetail: Nubank vice-chair Roberto Campos Neto (former Central Bank of Brazil governor) announced a dollar-pegged stablecoin pilot tied to credit-card payments at Meridian 2025. Nubank serves 100M+ customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia; integrated USDC inside the app since 2023. The credit-card pilot is the first product surface, with a broader 'tokenize deposits and issue credit against tokenized assets' roadmap behind it. Whether Nubank issues its own dollar token or routes through an existing stablecoin (Campos Neto noted the open product question) is undecided; ticker, chain, and reserve disclosure model not yet confirmed. Pharos opens this pre-launch entry against the announced own-issuance interpretation; will be retired if Nubank's pilot instead routes through USDC/PYUSD/other tracked tokens.
